Consider the data on the body mass (kg) and brain mass (gm) for 62 species of mammals shown in @fig-mammal-mass. (You can hover the cursor over a point to see the species name.)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-mammal-mass
#| warning: false
library(ggformula)
library(ggiraph)
mammals <- read.csv("../www/mammals.csv")
P <- mammals |> 
  ggformula:::gf_point_interactive(brain_weight ~ body_weight,
                       tooltip = paste("Species: ", mammals$species)) |>
  gf_refine(
    scale_y_log10(),
    scale_x_log10(),
    coord_fixed()
  ) |>
  gf_lm(interval = "prediction", level = 0.67) |>
  gf_labs(y = "Brain mass (gm)", x = "Body mass (kg)") |>
  gf_theme(theme_minimal())
P |> gf_girafe()
```

1. The lesser short-tailed shrew has both the smallest body mass and brain mass. What is the brain mass of the short-tailed shrew? (Pick the answer that's closest.)

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_msp.1.4lse
- '0.03 gm':
    correct: false
- '0.14 gm':
    correct: true
- '0.52 gm':
    correct: false
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
Q <- devoirs_selection(
  label = "msp-1-4lse",
  question = "Placeholder for now",
  answers = choices_msp.1.4lse,
  multiple = FALSE
)
Q(inline = TRUE)
```

@fig-mammal-sleep shows the daily sleeping time versus lifetime for the 62 mammals. The level of danger from predation that the animal is exposed to is shown by color.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-mammal-sleep
#| warning: false
library(ggformula)
library(ggiraph)
mammals <- read.csv("../www/mammals.csv")
P <- mammals |> 
  ggformula:::gf_point_interactive(total_sleep ~ lifespan, color = ~ danger,
                       tooltip = paste("Species: ", mammals$species, "<br>Danger", mammals$danger)) |>
  gf_refine(
    scale_x_log10(),
    scale_color_viridis_c()
  ) |>
  gf_labs(y = "Sleep (hrs per day)", x = "Lifespan (yr)") |>
  gf_theme(theme_minimal())
P |> gf_girafe()
```

6. The mammal who sleeps the least sleeps how many hours per day?

- 'Can''t tell the difference on this scale.':

```

```
